05 London 11 08 67
* 1967-08-11
Comments
* Please note that the correct date of this show appears to be 02 August 1967. It is not a Perfumed Garden, but a late afternoon/early evening show. Judging by Peel's remarks, he has just returned to the ship after a period of shore leave.
* This show is available in two versions: one on the 17-DVD Torrent, and the other as a remastered show from the blog My Old Tapes.
* The author comments: "Inspired by the Final Perfumed Garden reconstruction, I've done the same with this show. There are a couple I couldn't source, and one or two that I could only find in mono but by and large i think the end result is more enjoyable to listen to than the version in John Peel torrent 8 (or 7 is it?). Thanks to the original uploader though! I am very grateful."
